text: Vietnam International Financial Center in HCMC welcomes seven new members

The Vietnam International Financial Centre in Ho Chi Minh City (VIFC-HCMC) announced seven new members on November 23, expanding its ecosystem to cover investment capital mobilisation, commodity trading infrastructure, advisory services and technology solutions.

The announcement was made at a ceremony held at the City Planning Exhibition Centre, as part of a conference unveiling Ho Chi Minh City's master plan for 2025-2050, with a 100-year vision, according to the Government's online newspaper (chinhphu.vn).
According to VIFC-HCMC, the seven new members have combined initial charter capital of approximately $100 million and are expected to mobilise $5 billion during 2027-2030.

They comprise Vietnam Green Energy Investment Holding JSC, Mekong Capital VIFC Limited, Charming Land Vietnam Company Limited, IFC Viet Nam International Commodity Exchange Single-member Limited Liability Company, Buon Ma Thuot Coffee and Commodity Exchange Company Limited (BCCE Co., Ltd), 3V Advisors International Company Limited and Corvia Technology Company Limited.
The latest announcement follows the introduction of VIFC-HCMC's first 10 members at the Autumn Economic Forum in October 2026.
Those members were expected to mobilise and invest approximately $2.7 billion by 2027.
With both announcements combined, the total capital expected to be mobilised by VIFC-HCMC members is projected to reach $7.7 billion during 2027-2030.
